text:
Aisha Patel: Quick heads-up — we're lining up a 90m cross-customer enablement for the migration cohort (Veridian / Nimbus / CobaltMed). Goal: get them from PoC to low-risk Dedicated cutover. Need to lock timeblocks that cover NA/EMEA overlap + at least one APAC-friendly session. Can folks add availability + volunteer to own segments?

Matt Chen: I can do Tue 10–11 PT or Wed 2–3 PT (both work for NA/EU overlap). I can cover the Dedicated capacity sizing bit. :thumbsup:

Samir Gomez: Wed 14:00 PT works better for EMEA folks — that hits early evening for UK. I can handle the KV cache + batching demo. Also flagging: Veridian said they want a 15m renewal-risk check-in inside the session.

Lina Rodriguez: I’ll own the agenda and slide deck. Draft agenda below — please comment with edits. I can convert to a short Notion doc after we lock time.

Lina Rodriguez: ```
- 0–10m: Introductions + desired outcomes (Aisha)
- 10–35m: Dedicated migration checklist + preflight (Matt)
- 35–60m: Live demo: batching, KV cache, observability (Samir)
- 60–75m: Customer-specific risk checks (15m breakout for each)
- 75–90m: Q&A + next steps + recording links (Aisha/Jacob)
```

Jacob Lee: I’ll handle recording + calendar invites and set a soft RSVP cap of 25 so we can keep it interactive. Also will enable captions.

Aisha Patel: For dates, quick poll — react with :one: for Tue May 17 10–11 PT, :two: for Wed May 18 14–15 PT, :three: for Fri May 20 23–00 PT (APAC friendly). If you can’t emoji-react, reply with availability.

Matt Chen: :two: — confirmed.

Samir Gomez: :two: as well.

Lina Rodriguez: Taking :two:, will prep slide deck + two short customer-specific breakouts (Veridian + Nimbus). Can someone from CSM own CobaltMed breakout?

Enablement Bot: Calendar placeholder created: "Migration Cohort: Low-risk Dedicated Cutover" — tentative Wed 2026-05-18 14:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd1234

Aisha Patel: Thanks all. Samir/Matt/Lina/Jacob — let's sync 30m tomorrow to review slides and breakout prompts. I'll DM a few times to coordinate.

Jacob Lee: Noted — I'll send the invite for the prep sync and attach a quick runbook for breakout leads.

Aisha Patel: Also tagging @CobaltMed-CS (please confirm a rep can join the breakouts).

Samir Gomez: Pinged CobaltMed rep, they said yes to Wed.

Lina Rodriguez: Great — I'll draft the Notion with the agenda + prep checklist and post the link here once ready.

Matt Chen: Thanks — happy to jump on any last-minute dry run.

Aisha Patel: Closing — tentative slot Wed May 18 14:00 PT. Will publish official invite + Notion after prep sync. :rocket:
